displayName.description: Who held the seat, when no account can be attached to it

image.description: Asset file name of the member's portrait

userId.description: The member holding the seat; absent for somebody with no account

AddRosterEntryRequest.description: Put somebody on a team's roster for a season

description.description: A short caption about them, in markdown

game.description: The game the team is fielded in; naming somebody fields it there

icon.description: Where this entry's picture is stored; nothing leaves it without one

roleTitle.description: What they did in the team's own words, beside the fixed part

userId.description: The member this entry belongs to, when they are known

ApiError.description: Problem Details for HTTP APIs including validation errors.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

errors.description: List of field/object validation errors (present when binding/validation fails).

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the problem.

traceId.description: Trace or correlation id if available (Spring may add this via problem detail handlers).

description.description: The personal note the board page shows beside a member

id.description: The seat's own id, which is how it is edited or removed

image.description: Asset file name of the member's portrait

name.description: Who held the seat: the linked member's name, or the recorded one

userId.description: The member holding the seat, when one is linked to it

image.description: Asset file name of the board's own photograph

BulkMoveTargetsRequest.description: Where to file several targets at once.

externalIds.description: The external ids of the targets to move, as the system itself names them.

folder.description: The folder to move them into. Must already exist in the system.

BulkRowVocabulary.description: Contract-only holder that publishes the bulk-action enums. Not returned by any endpoint.

BulkTargetMoveResult.description: The outcome of moving several targets.

failed.description: The targets the system refused, and what it said. Empty when all moved.

moved.description: The targets that were moved, as the system now describes them.

definitionKey.description: Which definition in code decides who belongs to this cohort

lastReconciledAt.description: When this cohort was last confirmed to agree with its target

path.description: Where the target sits on its system, outside in: the system, then any folder holding it. Read from what was recorded when the target was linked or moved, so a page costs no call to the system.

definitionKey.description: Which definition in code decides who belongs here

orphaned.description: True when no definition produces this cohort any more

externalLabel.description: What the external system calls this row

externalUserId.description: The row's identity in the external system, where it has one

state.description: Whether this row is in step with the external system

system.description: Which system's ledger this row belongs to

userId.description: Null for a row present externally with no local account

role.description: What this member does on the committee. Omitted for a member who simply sits on it, which is most of them.

image.description: Asset file name of the board's photograph

CreateGameRequest.description: A game the association has started playing

accent.description: The colour that carries this game, or nothing for the island's own

banner.description: Where the game's banner is stored

icon.description: Where the game's icon is stored

slug.description: The address this game answers to

sortIndex.description: Where it sits among the others; left out, it goes at the end

nameOnRosters.description: Whether this member's real name may appear in a roster

CreateTeamRequest.description: Create a team. A team is the association's rather than a game's, so it names none

icon.description: Where the team's icon is stored; nothing leaves the team without one

previewable.description: Whether this email's body was stored, so it can be previewed

payload.description: Job payload fields keyed by name; shape depends on the job type

FailedTargetMove.description: One target the external system would not move.

message.description: What the system said, for an operator to act on rather than a stack trace.

FieldTeamRequest.description: Field a team in a game in a season, with or without the line-up it last had

banner.description: Where the art for this fielding is stored; nothing leaves what it has

carryFrom.description: Which of this team's line-ups to copy across; wins over carryLineup

carryLineup.description: Copy the line-up this team last had in this game into this season

game.description: The game it is being fielded in. A team may play more than one in a season

FieldValidationError.description: Details about a single field/object validation error.

field.description: Field that failed validation (null for global errors).

message.example: must be a well-formed email address

refs.description: Identifiers the error refers to when they are not numeric — an external system's own ids, for instance. The counterpart of `values`; an error carries one or the other, never both.

items.description: Identifiers the error refers to when they are not numeric — an external system's own ids, for instance. The counterpart of `values`; an error carries one or the other, never both.

values.description: Identifiers the error refers to, when the failing field carries a collection. Lets a client name the offending rows and reload them rather than restate the whole request.

items.description: Identifiers the error refers to, when the failing field carries a collection. Lets a client name the offending rows and reload them rather than restate the whole request.

FieldedTeamResponse.description: A team now fielded in a season, and whatever line-up came across with it

banner.description: The art it is drawn with this season, carried across from the last one it played

carried.description: The entries copied from the team's last season; empty when nothing was carried

game.description: The game it was fielded in

FieldingResponse.description: A team fielded in a game in a season, which is where a line-up hangs

GameAccountRequest.description: Set what a member is called in one game

GameAccountResponse.description: What one member is called in one game

GameContentsResponse.description: What a game holds, for a removal to say before it happens

teams.description: Teams recorded in it, across every season

GameResponse.description: A game: what it is called, the art it is drawn with, and how it is presented

accent.description: The colour that carries this game, where one has been chosen

code.description: The identifier teams, rosters and game accounts reference. Never changes

current.description: Whether the association currently plays it: a team played it this season or last

intro.description: What is said about the game, where anything is said

slug.description: The address this game answers to

sortIndex.description: Where the game sits among the others

GameRostersResponse.description: A game's teams for one season, and the seasons that can be shown

season.description: The season being shown; absent when the game has no rosters yet

Image.description: An image a public page draws, and the widths it is stored at

height.description: How tall it is, absent where its size could not be read

path.description: Where it is stored, which is what a save points at to put it on a record

renditions.description: The widths it is stored at, narrowest first

url.description: Where the full-size image is served

width.description: How wide it is, absent where its size could not be read

ImageRendition.description: One stored width of an image

LineupSourceRequest.description: One line-up of a team's: which game it was played in, and which season

userId.description: The member to attach to the seat; absent detaches it

LinkRosterEntryRequest.description: Attach a roster entry to a member, or detach it with a null id

nameOnRosters.description: Whether this member's real name may appear in a roster

folder.description: The folder to move the target into. Must already exist in the system.

PendingActivation.description: The activation email an account that has not been activated takes.

purpose.description: Which activation email applies to it.

PendingActivationsResponse.description: Which activation email applies to each account that has not been activated. Accounts that are already active do not appear.

RecoveryEmailPreviewResponse.description: A recovery email rendered for inspection. No token was issued to produce it.

html.description: The rendered email, as delivered but for the inert recovery link.

linkPlaceholder.description: What the recovery link carries in place of a token, so the preview can say the link is inert.

recipientEmail.description: Address the email would be sent to.

recipientName.description: Name the email addresses the recipient by.

subject.description: Subject line the recipient would see.

RosterEntryResponse.description: A roster entry as an admin edits it, real name included

description.description: A short caption about them, in markdown

displayName.description: The member's real name, shown to admins for identification

icon.description: This entry's uploaded picture, where one was uploaded

roleTitle.description: What they did in the team's own words

userId.description: The member this entry belongs to, when anybody could be identified

RosterMemberResponse.description: One person on a team's roster, as the public read has them

description.description: A short caption about them, in markdown, where anything was written

handle.description: What this member is called in the game

icon.description: This entry's uploaded picture, where one was uploaded

name.description: The member's real name, present only when they allow it to be shown

roleTitle.description: What they did in the team's own words, where anything was said

SeasonContentsResponse.description: What a season holds, for a removal to say before it happens

players.description: Roster places held in it, across those teams

teams.description: Teams fielded in it, across every game

SeasonGameResponse.description: A game that ran in a season, with what it fielded

public.description: Whether a visitor sees it: a game is public in a season once a team plays it

SeasonResponse.description: A stretch of play that rosters belong to

played.description: Whether anything was fielded in it, which is which seasons a visitor is offered

html.description: The email's html with every url stripped out

linksRedacted.description: Always true: the preview's links were removed before it left the api

TeamResponse.description: A team the association fields in one game

icon.description: The team's own icon, drawn beside the name. The banner it is drawn on belongs to the fielding, not to the team

TeamRosterResponse.description: A team with the roster it fielded in one season

icon.description: The team's own icon, shown beside the name

image.description: Asset file name of the board's photograph

accent.description: The colour that carries this game, or nothing for the island's own

banner.description: Where the game's banner is stored; nothing takes the banner away

icon.description: Where the game's icon is stored; nothing takes the icon away

name.description: What this game is called. Its code is not editable

slug.description: The address this game answers to

nameOnRosters.description: Whether this member's real name may appear in a roster

description.description: A short caption about them, in markdown

icon.description: Where this entry's picture is stored; nothing takes the picture away

roleTitle.description: What they did in the team's own words, beside the fixed part

UpdateTeamRequest.description: Rename a team or change its icon. Its banner belongs to the fielding

icon.description: Where the team's icon is stored; nothing takes the icon away

nameOnRosters.description: Whether this member's real name may appear in a roster
